added: Settings › Swipe actions: choose what swiping a card left or right does, separately for chores, tasks and reminders. Each swipe can log or mark done, snooze, archive, delete, or do nothing, within what that list supports.
Swipe to archive a chore, task or reminder without logging or completing it, with an Undo.
Swipe to snooze a reminder: its next ring moves back an hour, with an Undo.
Swipe to delete a task, behind the same confirmation as the edit sheet.
changed: Swiping a done reminder or task with the Done action now restores it instead of marking it done again.
